01 · Website

A website you own, hosted free

Next.js, the code in your GitHub, on Vercel. Preview every change before it goes live. Stop paying Wix or GoDaddy.

02 · Search and AI search

Found by Google and by AI

Schema on every page: FAQs, authorship, services and review stars per service, so Gemini and ChatGPT can recommend you by name.

  • Local pages that answer real questions
  • Structured data an AI can read

03 · Reviews

Google profile and reviews, worked hard

Complete profiles get seven times more clicks. We request a review after every job and answer every one.

  • Profile fully built out and posted weekly
  • Review requests by text, timed to the job
  • Every review answered in your voice
04 · Funnels

Funnels, not contact forms

Qualifying questions, address autofill, your offer and your reviews, then a booking calendar or a call-back button.

  • 20 to 30% conversion against a 5% average
  • One funnel per service and per ad
  • Every submission lands in the CRM
05 · Phones

An AI receptionist that gets you the call first

Clear audio on a Tier 1 carrier. Takes details, rings your team, and if nobody answers, books a callback or takes a message.

  • One tracked number per source
  • Call recording and transcripts
  • After-hours booking, not voicemail
06 · CRM

Your CRM, with AI follow-up

Text and email reply in under a minute, pipelines, booking, closed-job value and the return-on-spend dashboard.

Questions

The things every owner asks.

What does one company per trade per city mean?

We cap how many companies we take in each trade and each city, so our clients are never fighting each other for the same calls. Your spot is yours for as long as you are with us. When the spots are gone, they are gone.

What does it cost?

About 10% of revenue in three lines a month: a $797 platform base, our work itemised, and ad spend billed to you directly by Google and Meta. A $500K company runs about $4,250 a month. Setup from scratch is $5,000 to $7,500, refunded if you do not like the website design we show you first.

What happens to leads outside my city?

Leads outside your area go to a trusted provider you approve, who sends you theirs.

Is there a contract?

No. Month to month, cancel any time. You leave with the website code, the data, the phone numbers and the ad accounts, and we help the next provider get set up.

Do you work outside the Phoenix area?

Yes. Everything is remote-capable and we expand city by city. Phoenix owners get Brian in person for the proposal.

Founder. Author of The Salesman Who Doesn’t Sell, a marketing guide to making money while you sleep. More at briangreenberg.com.

Brian built True Blue Life Insurance from a one-person agency into a company that sold more than $50 million of policies online, ranked in the top 1% of agents worldwide, and sold it in 2022. He did it without cold calls: his customers found him on Google, read his reviews, and booked themselves. He built and sold two more companies the same way, an SEO agency in 2012 and BJG Digital in 2025, and today runs Quoteplicity, the quoting platform behind more than 200,000 insurance leads.

“I never wanted to pressure anyone. So I built systems where customers sell themselves.” That system, the reviews, the search rankings and the booking funnel, is what Rocket Llama Labs installs for one trade in one area at a time. Branson and Madison run the day to day; Brian runs the strategy and sits in on every proposal.

Brand book v1.0

Eight rules, held on every page

  1. 1Supplied logo files only, never redrawn or recolored. The footer wordmark sits on a white plate instead of being inverted.
  2. 2Clear space around every logo of at least the cap height of the R.
  3. 3Navy Montserrat Bold headings. 16px Inter body minimum. Nothing under 12px.
  4. 4One blue primary button per screen. The header and the mobile action bar are outlined navy, so each page has exactly one blue button.
  5. 5Four colors only: navy, blue, mist, white. Photography sits under a flat navy overlay. The mascot keeps its own palette.
  6. 6No gradients. Every band, bar, ring and chart is a flat fill.
  7. 7Sentence case everywhere. No exclamation marks. No all-caps headings, no emoji.
  8. 8One H1 per page, alt text on every logo, the mascot as favicon.
